mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpIvDivsnDeliveryPlanAlterPopList*/ SELECT A.PO_NO , A.PO_SEQ , B.DS_SEQ , B.DS_DATE , B.CD_QTY , NVL(C.INV_QTY,0) AS INV_QTY , B.ADD_USER_ID --수주접수자 , TRIM(A.DS_DELAY_REASON) AS DS_DELAY_REASON --지연사유 , B.DS_REMARK -- 예정일변경사유 FROM ICOMPODT A , ICOMPORS B , ICOMIVDT C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND A.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER(+) AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO(+) AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ(+) AND B.DS_DATE = C.DS_DATE(+) AND A.DS_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS(+) <> 'D'
mapper.update: /*insertDivsnDeliveryPlanAlterPors*/ INSERT INTO ICOMPORS ( BUYER , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DS_SEQ , STATUS , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SELLER , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE , CD_DATE , CD_QTY , DS_DATE , ADD_USER_ID , ADMIN_FLAG1 , BUYER_DS_DATE , AGENCY_USER_ID ) ( SELECT BUYER , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , (SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(DS_SEQ)+1,1),'FM000000') FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER=#{buyer} AND PO_NO=#{po_no} AND PO_SEQ=#{po_seq}) , 'C' , ' ' , ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , ' ' , ' ' , SELLER , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , UNIT_MEASURE , #{cd_date} , #{cd_qty} , #{cd_date} , #{user_id} , #{admin_flag1} , DECODE(PROCESS_TYPE,'0',#{cd_date},'2',F_GET_WORKINGDAY(#{cd_date},2)) , #{user_id} FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{buyer} AND PO_NO = #{po_no} AND PO_SEQ = #{po_seq} AND STATUS != 'D' )
